1.602.titolo: The same decimal numbers on iPhone, web and in sentences
voci: On the iPhone and in the widget an expected fantasy score like 6.35 reads “6.3”, as on the web: before, the iPhone wrote “6.4”. It happened to about two numbers in five among those ending in 5 (6.35, 5.55, 7.05, 8.45…), also in the table of the 11 in the Lineup.
The differences written next to the numbers, like “Better than expected: Rossi (+1.2)” in Matchdays, always match the two numbers you read.
On the web a number just below zero is written “0.0”, no longer “-0.0”.

1.601.titolo: Import rosters: teams named like a club and trades seen correctly
voci: Import rosters: one of your teams with the same name as a Serie A club (“Roma”, “AS Roma”, “Inter”) is now recognised as a team in the Excel file with teams side by side, in pasted text after a blank line and when it is already saved in the league. Where it is not clear, the preview says so and explains what to do.
If a team ends up with too many players because the name of a league team was taken for a club, the message says which name and what to do, instead of just “has 50 players”.
When you re-import only your own roster after a trade, “What changes” and the history show the right move even if the saved roster of the other team is old.
In text with one name per line, “Crediti residui: 37” is read even when the players have no club and cost next to them.
“Players to fix”: if the rosters cannot be read, the web app and the iPhone say so in place of the list. On the iPhone, with two identical rows in the same team, matching one removes only that one.

1.599.titolo: Predictions updated even with a match brought forward by weeks, and a more precise deadline alert
voci: Expected fantasy score: if a match of the matchday has been brought forward by weeks (for example for the Super Cup) or to midweek, the predictions also count the matches played in the meantime, such as the previous matchday.
Alert before the deadline: it also goes off when the new recommended lineup is worth exactly one more expected point, for example 64.1 against 63.1.

Recommended lineup: if one of its starters no longer has a prediction (removed from the player list or with a changed role), the new recommendation still keeps the players of matches already started in their place.

1.598.titolo: Lineup: the old probable lineups warning no longer repeats hours and deadline
voci: Lineup, probable lineups read at least six hours ago with the deadline close: the warning only says “The probable lineups may have changed: check them again before the lineup closes.” The line above says when they were read, the header says when the lineup closes. Same on iPhone.

1.596.titolo: A more precise Privacy page about whoever runs the app, and the right message when signing up without emails
voci: The Privacy page says everything whoever runs the app sees in Management: also the last sign-in, the block with its date, the comments sent with “Write to us” and the latest security events. Updated on 27 Nov 2026.

Where signing up needs you to confirm your email but the server cannot send emails, the message no longer asks you for an invitation you already have: it says emails are turned off and that you should let whoever runs the server know.

1.595.titolo: More privacy in the logs and in the new sign-in email
voci: “Sign-in from a new device” email: the device is described in plain words, for example “iPhone, Safari” or “SchieraXI app”, instead of the long technical string of the program.
The server's request log keeps only the page asked for, without team names and the other choices that come with it.
Management, “Recent errors”: important events (sign-ups, password recoveries, deletions, role changes, blocks, invitations) stay in the list even after many wrong sign-in attempts.

1.594.titolo: Clearer “Refresh the data” and Management, and My team even offline
voci: Management, “Refresh the data”: if a source does not respond, the message says so with one sentence per line, for example “Fantacalcio.it is not responding: try again later.”, instead of the technical message that covered the screen.

A refresh in which no data arrives no longer changes the date of the data (“data as of …” under the title), and for whoever runs the server the “The match data has not been updated for …” warning stays until the data really arrives.
Management: after “Block”, “Unblock” or “Delete”, “Users' comments” and “Recent errors” are refreshed right away too.
Settings: when offline, “My team” stays in its place, greyed out, with the sentence “Opens when the server can be reached again”.

1.593.titolo: Account: invitation for a group, clearer account deletion, one message at a time
voci: Management, New invitation: with “How many people” the same link works for a group of friends, to send in the chat.
Delete the account: the app first checks your password, then asks you to confirm; afterwards the sign-in page says that the account and its data have been deleted. The same on iPhone.
Sign in: after too many attempts the button counts down by itself, and in Sign up the username rules are under the field. The same on iPhone.
When the session ends there is only one message; in Management, Recent errors, “Signed out of all devices” says whose it is.

1.420.titolo: Missing make-up games written like the postponed matches
voci: When a matchday is over, the line about missing make-up games writes the matches like the postponed matches card: “ATA vs PAR”. Same on phone and computer.

1.328.titolo: More accurate expected fantasy score for the most expensive players
voci: The expected match grade of the most expensive players is much less overestimated: before, it was on average about a tenth higher than the real one, now half of that or less, in both seasons tested.

1.292.titolo: Example teams even with sources off
voci: “Use the example teams” and roster import also work when whoever runs the server has turned Fantacalcio.it off: the players already saved are used.
When a new version is out, a small “Update ready – Reload” notice appears.
On tablets the app can now be rotated to landscape.
The preview images show up even before signing in.
Lineups and predictions work even when the expected goals (xG) statistics are not there yet: they no longer give an error.
With English selected, the verdict on trades (good for you, for them or for neither), the explanation of the numbers and the reasons why a trade cannot be made are also written in English.
With English selected, the "Under the hood" texts (explanations, formulas, glossary and names of the measures) are also written in English.
With English selected, the alerts about a position with too few players or no backup (for example "You have only 2 defenders available...") are also written in English.
In Settings > Appearance you can also choose Market, Trades and League as your start section, besides Today and Lineup.

1.209.titolo: More readable app on large screens
voci: On large screens (Full HD, 2K, ultrawide) the app scales up by itself: text and buttons stay readable with the browser at 100%, and the cards spread over more columns without big empty spaces.

1.208.titolo: English: "To do", reasons and probable lineups
voci: With English selected, the "To do" sentences (doubts about starters, deadlines, data copies), the reasons behind the advice (for example "starter at 85%") and the time of the probable lineups are also written in English.

1.207.titolo: Privacy and Terms also in English
voci: The Privacy, Terms of use, Credits and "Delete your account" pages can now also be read in English: with English selected, the links in the app open the English version. At the top it says it is a translation and links to the Italian text, which is the one that counts.

1.206.titolo: English: guided setup and first start
voci: With English selected, the guided first sign-in and the first-start steps (rosters, team, crest, installation, widget, alerts) are also in English.

1.205.titolo: English: alerts, backup, diary, search and icon
voci: With English selected, alerts, the safety copy, the matchday diary, the model test, player search, the app icon and the lineup image to share are also in English.

1.204.titolo: English: Team, More, Rules and What's new
voci: With English selected, the Team and More entries, the Rules screen, What's new, Under the hood, crest and shirt and the season change are also in English.
The Privacy page explains that, if you ask, whoever runs the app can import your rosters for you and keeps the last 5 copies of your previous rosters, deleted together with your account.
If you import your rosters twice almost at the same time, the second waits for the first: no more rosters lost or mixed up.

1.201.titolo: English: Trades, roster and data status
voci: With English selected, Trades (find, build, evaluate an offer), the roster page and the data status are also in English.
"Show all features" only shows the menus: features turned off by whoever runs the app, such as images from a web address and live results, stay off for everyone.
With English selected, the Market (recommended, players, watchlist, calendar), the player page and the comparison are also in English.

1.198.titolo: More readable pitch in the light theme
voci: In the light theme the green pitch is a little darker, so the names and numbers in white are easier to read.

1.197.titolo: Sign-in in the middle of the screen
voci: On a computer the sign-in page (and sign-up, forgotten password and the guided first start) now sits in the middle of the screen, no longer low down.
